blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The camp of Vice President Sara Duterte on Tuesday challenged the Anti-Money Laundering Council’s (AMLC) supposed confirmation that a company linked to her and her husband received funds from China, claiming that what it only actually confirmed is that former Senator Antonio Trillanes IV illegally obtained the records showing the transactions. This came after AMLC Executive Director Ronel Buenaventura confirmed during Tuesday’s impeachment proceedings that CALE88 Foods Corp., the food company owned by Duterte’s husband Manases Carpio, received funds over P319 million from China.
